label: tsuneyodorm20
title_zh: 操……或者说活着意味着什么（盐与酱油）

lines.en: label tsuneyodorm20:
I knock on the door, hoping that Molly has decided to dress Tsuneyo up as another fictional character she’s attracted to tonight.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲门，心里盼着 Molly 今晚又决定把 Tsuneyo 打扮成她喜欢的另一个虚构角色。

lines.en: And while that situation is unlikely due to the fact that it has only happened one out of the many times I’ve been here, the dream lives on.
lines.zh: 虽然这种事不太可能——我来过这么多次，只赶上过一次——但梦想还是要有的。

lines.en: : Come in!
lines.zh: : 请进！

lines.en: Uta?
lines.zh: Uta？

lines.en: Did I knock on the wrong door?
lines.zh: 我敲错门了？

lines.en: I take a step back to confirm that I did, in fact, knock on the door to room #6.
lines.zh: 我后退一步确认，我敲的确实是 6 号房的门。

lines.en: So...unless the girls swapped rooms or roommates, it seems as if I have, once again, stumbled upon more than I’ve bargained for.
lines.zh: 那么……除非女孩们换了房间或室友，看来我又一次撞上了超出预期的场面。

lines.en: scene black
scene tsuneyouta1
: Ohohoh~ A late night visit from the teacher.
lines.zh: : 哦吼吼～老师深夜来访。

lines.en: : I knew something was going on when Tsuneyo asked me to come talk to her, but I didn’t think it would end like {i}this.{/i}
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo 叫我过来跟她聊聊的时候，我就知道有情况，但我没想到会是{i}这种结局{/i}。

lines.en: : To think my first time would be a threesome with two of the tallest people I know...
lines.zh: : 没想到我的第一次会是和我认识的两个最高的人玩三……

lines.en: : What are you two planning on doing with little ole’ Uta?
lines.zh: : 你们两个打算拿小小的 Uta 怎么办呀？

lines.en: : Are you here to see Uta, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师，你是来找 Uta 的吗？

lines.en: : Why would I have knocked on {i}your{/i} door if I was here to see Uta?
lines.zh: : 如果我找的是 Uta，我干吗敲{i}你{/i}的门？

lines.en: : Oooooh okay, so you were looking for solo action and want me to film it.
lines.zh: : 哦————好吧，所以你想要的是单人动作戏，还想让我来拍。

lines.en: : I’ll go get Io’s camera. Hold on one sec.
lines.zh: : 我去拿 Io 的相机。等我一下。

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta2
: Solo action?
lines.zh: : 单人动作戏？

lines.en: : You know! Knockin’ boots. Bumpin’ uglies. The old fashioned beef injection.
lines.zh: : 你懂的！就是那档子事。颠鸾倒凤。老式的牛肉注射。

lines.en: : I didn’t like that last one at all.
lines.zh: : 最后那个我一点都不喜欢。

lines.en: : I think a beef injection sounds delicious.
lines.zh: : 我觉得牛肉注射听起来挺好吃的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta3
: Hold on a sec, you really have no idea what I’m talking about?
lines.zh: : 等等，你真的听不懂我在说什么？

lines.en: : You can’t be that innocent, can you?
lines.zh: : 你不可能纯情到这种地步吧？

lines.en: : I’m not innocent.
lines.zh: : 我可不纯情。

lines.en: : If injecting the beef is a crime, lock me away now.
lines.zh: : 如果注射牛肉是犯罪，那现在就把我关起来吧。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo’s lived a very sheltered life, Uta. Please do not corrupt her before I can.
lines.zh: : Uta，Tsuneyo 一直过着与世隔绝的生活。请别在我之前把她教坏。

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta4
: Ooooh okay, okay!
lines.zh: : 哦——好好，好好！

lines.en: : The last half hour is startin’ to make a lot more sense to me now.
lines.zh: : 这半个钟头的事儿总算都说得通了。

lines.en: : I reached out to Uta for the sake of my father, as I know she has experience in caring for people.
lines.zh: : 我是为了我父亲才去找 Uta 的，因为我知道她有照顾人的经验。

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta5
: Hope I didn’t talk your ear off with all of my advice.
lines.zh: : 但愿我那一堆建议没把你耳朵磨出茧子。

lines.en: : You sound really close to your pops and I’m startin' to get why.
lines.zh: : 你跟你爸感情真好，我开始明白为什么了。

lines.en: : You don’t have anybody else, huh?
lines.zh: : 你没有别的亲人了吧？

lines.en: : I’m afraid I do not. My mother has not been in the picture for quite some time.
lines.zh: : 恐怕没有。我母亲已经很久不在我的生活里了。

lines.en: : And if anything happens to my father, I will be more alone in this world than anyone has ever been before.
lines.zh: : 如果我父亲出了什么事，我将成为这个世界上前所未有的孤独之人。

lines.en: : Well, I sure hope everything turns out okay!
lines.zh: : 哎呀，我真心希望一切都能好起来！

lines.en: : And if it doesn’t, I’ll ask my parents to adopt you once the barrier opens back up.
lines.zh: : 万一不好，等结界重新打开，我就让我父母收养你。

lines.en: : Oh! You could be my little sister! Doesn’t that sound fun?
lines.zh: : 哦！你可以当我妹妹！听起来是不是很有意思？

lines.en: : I think you’d be better suited to be the little sister, Uta.
lines.zh: : 我觉得更适合当妹妹的是你吧，Uta。

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta6
: Come on! I’ve always wanted a little sister and I’ve been stuck {i}being{/i} the little sister ever since I was born!
lines.zh: : 拜托！我一直想要个妹妹，可从出生起我就一直被迫{i}当{/i}妹妹！

lines.en: : That is how being born as a little sister works, yes.
lines.zh: : 生下来就是妹妹，本来就是这么回事，没错。

lines.en: : You two seem very close.
lines.zh: : 你们两个看起来关系很好。

lines.en: : Do you fuck Uta the same way you fuck me, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师，你操 Uta 的方式，跟操我的方式一样吗？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : {i}Isn't she supposed to be innocent?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她不是应该很纯情吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}What have you done to this poor girl?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你对这可怜的女孩做了什么？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Am I next?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我是下一个吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It’s a long story. She doesn’t know what that word means yet.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}说来话长。她还不知道那个词是什么意思。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You should tell her!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你应该告诉她！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But it’s so fun this way...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可这样太好玩了……{/i}

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta7
: Uhh...
: You’re a real special girl, Tsunecchi.
lines.zh: : 你真是个特别的女孩，Tsunecchi。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta8
: Ah-
She does that when she says her own name as well?...
lines.zh: 她说到自己的名字时也会这样？……

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta9
: Tsunecchi is your nickname. It sounds more fun than Tsuneyo, don’t ya think?
lines.zh: : Tsunecchi 是你的昵称。比 Tsuneyo 听起来更好玩，你不觉得吗？

lines.en: : I understand. In that case, I shall give you a nickname as well.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。那么，我也给你取个昵称。

lines.en: : Hit me! I’m ready for any nickname you give me!
lines.zh: : 来吧！你给我取的什么昵称我都接！

lines.en: : I feel like you are going to regret those words very shortly.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你很快就会后悔说这句话。

lines.en: : From this day forth, I will refer to you as...Green Onion.
lines.zh: : 从今天起，我就叫你……青葱。

lines.en: : See?
lines.zh: : 看吧？

lines.en: : Tsunecchi, why do you want to call me Green Onion?
lines.zh: : Tsunecchi，你为什么想叫我青葱？

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta10
: The Green Onion is a delightful addition to a bowl of ramen, just as you are a delightful addition to my life.
lines.zh: : 青葱是一碗拉面里令人愉悦的点缀，正如你是我生命中令人愉悦的点缀。

lines.en: : It is also one of the key ingredients in Kansai based ramen, and you are from the Kansai region.
lines.zh: : 它也是关西风味拉面的关键配料之一，而你来自关西地区。

lines.en: : Those are actually really thoughtful and cute reasons.
lines.zh: : 这些理由其实还挺用心、挺可爱的。

lines.en: : Yeah, there was a lot more thought put into that than I expected.
lines.zh: : 是啊，比我想象的用心多了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta11
: Okay! From this day forth, Uta Ushibori will be known as Green Onion!
lines.zh: : 好！从今天起，Uta Ushibori 就叫青葱了！

lines.en: : You took to that way too easily. Defend your family name, Uta.
lines.zh: : 你也接受得太快了吧。捍卫一下你的姓氏啊，Uta。

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta12
: Any last questions for me before I go back to my room?
lines.zh: : 我回房间之前还有别的问题要问我吗？

lines.en: : Io’s still waiting for me in there and I just realized I've been gone for a pretty long time.
lines.zh: : Io 还在里面等我，我刚发现我已经出来很久了。

lines.en: : I have no additional questions at this time.
lines.zh: : 目前我没有别的问题了。

lines.en: : Thank you very much for your assistance, Green Onion.
lines.zh: : 非常感谢你的帮助，青葱。

lines.en: : May flavor find its way home to you.
lines.zh: : 愿风味指引你回家。

lines.en: : What kind of goodbye is that?
lines.zh: : 这算什么告别语啊？

lines.en: : And to you as well, Tsunecchi.
lines.zh: : 也愿你一切安好，Tsunecchi。

lines.en: : You’re just going to go along with it?
lines.zh: : 你就这么顺着她来了？

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta13
: Heheheh...don’t stay up too late, you two.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿……你们两个别熬太晚哦。

lines.en: : Do not worry, Green Onion. We will fuck each other as quietly as possible so that no one will be disturbed.
lines.zh: : 别担心，青葱。我们会尽可能安静地操对方，保证不打扰到任何人。

lines.en: : You heard her, Uta.
lines.zh: : 你听到了，Uta。

lines.en: : Please explain what that means to her as soon as possible.
lines.zh: : 尽快跟她解释清楚那是什么意思。

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta14
Uta leaves the room and I’m finally left alone with the girl I actually came here to see.
lines.zh: Uta 离开房间，我终于和我真正想见的女孩独处了。

lines.en: : Have I been using that phrase incorrectly?
lines.zh: : 我一直用错那个词了吗？

lines.en: : To be completely honest...yes. As incorrectly as possible.
lines.zh: : 老实说……是的。错得不能再错了。

lines.en: : But I don’t think you’d be very happy to hear what it actually means.
lines.zh: : 但我觉得你听到它真正的意思，应该不会太高兴。

lines.en: : I’m sure I can handle it.
lines.zh: : 我肯定受得了。

lines.en: : If I am ever going to learn how to properly engage in conversation with my peers, I must know who I can fuck and when.
lines.zh: : 如果我想学会怎样正确地和同龄人交流，我就必须知道我能操谁、什么时候操。

lines.en: : Well, you see...
lines.zh: : 这个嘛，你看……

lines.en: : “Fucking” someone means having sex with them.
lines.zh: : “操”某个人，就是和对方做爱。

lines.en: : Can you remind me what sex is?
lines.zh: : 你能提醒我一下做爱是什么吗？

lines.en: : I remember hearing it from the blonde girl in our class, but that conversation contained many confusing things and I’m afraid I may have mixed some up.
lines.zh: : 我记得听我们班那个金发女孩说过，但那段对话里有很多让人费解的东西，我怕自己记混了。

lines.en: : Just ask Molly when she gets home.
lines.zh: : 等 Molly 回家你问她吧。

lines.en: : Giving you a textbook explanation of sex would be a very surreal experience for both of us.
lines.zh: : 给你来一段教科书式的性爱讲解，对我们两个来说都会是非常超现实的体验。

lines.en: : I feel as if I have made a grave mistake that I will have a hard time severing from my memory.
lines.zh: : 我觉得自己犯下了一个大错，而且它会牢牢粘在我的记忆里，很难抹掉。

lines.en: : Probably, but that’s a bridge we’ll cross another day.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧，不过那座桥我们改天再过。

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta15
: There are so many things I do not understand.
lines.zh: : 我不明白的事太多了。

lines.en: Tsuneyo takes a seat on her computer chair and hugs her knees for what I imagine is comfort.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 在她的电脑椅上坐下，抱住膝盖，我想这是为了让自己好受些。

lines.en: She already had to enlist the help of one of the most...outspoken members of the class tonight, so I’m sure she’s exhausted from having to talk for so long.
lines.zh: 今晚她已经不得不求助全班最……口无遮拦的成员之一，所以聊了这么久，她肯定累坏了。

lines.en: Or listen for so long.
lines.zh: 或者说听了这么久。

lines.en: But, then again, she deals with Molly on a daily basis...so maybe Uta wasn’t as much of a chore for her as I imagined she would be.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，她天天都在应付 Molly……所以 Uta 对她来说，也许没我想的那么难熬。

lines.en: : Like what?
lines.zh: : 比如什么？

lines.en: : Like fucking...or what it means to live.
lines.zh: : 比如操……或者活着意味着什么。

lines.en: : If it’s any consolation, those two things are pretty interchangeable in my book.
lines.zh: : 如果说有什么能安慰你的，那就是在我的观念里，这两件事基本可以互换。

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta16
: While Green Onion was able to provide me several useful tips for taking care of a loved one tonight, she also made things sound quite terrifying.
lines.zh: : 虽然青葱今晚给了我几条照顾亲人的实用建议，但她也把事情说得很吓人。

lines.en: : I’m beginning to understand that my father’s time here may be coming to an end.
lines.zh: : 我开始明白，我父亲在这里的时间或许正走向尽头。

lines.en: : He grows weaker day by day.
lines.zh: : 他一天比一天虚弱。

lines.en: : It isn’t long before he’s unable to recommend me swimming tubes or teach me the proper ways to slaughter birds.
lines.zh: : 要不了多久，他就不能再给我推荐游泳圈，也不能再教我正确的杀鸟方法了。

lines.en: : I feel as if it were just the other day he was teaching me the difference between shio and shoyu.
lines.zh: : 感觉就仿佛是前几天，他还在教我 shio（盐味）和 shoyu（酱油味）的区别。

lines.en: : The fear of death you mentioned recently is starting to make sense to me.
lines.zh: : 你最近提到的那种对死亡的恐惧，我开始理解了。

lines.en: : But it is not the act of death that torments me.
lines.zh: : 但折磨我的并不是死亡本身。

lines.en: : It is the thought of what comes after.
lines.zh: : 而是对死后之事的想象。

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta17
: I do not want my father to turn into a tree.
lines.zh: : 我不想让我父亲变成一棵树。

lines.en: : You can not talk to trees. And they teach you nothing.
lines.zh: : 树没法跟你说话。也教不了你任何东西。

lines.en: : Also, he will die in his room upstairs and a tree would be sure to crash through the floor and destroy the restaurant.
lines.zh: : 而且他会死在楼上自己的房间里，一棵树肯定会压穿地板，把餐厅砸烂。

lines.en: : What should I do?
lines.zh: : 我该怎么办？

lines.en: : Why ask me?
lines.zh: : 为什么问我？

lines.en: : Death isn’t something I’m particularly good at dealing with.
lines.zh: : 死亡可不是我擅长应付的东西。

lines.en: : And it’s not like I have all of the answers.
lines.zh: : 而且我也不是什么都知道。

lines.en: : Or...{i}any{/i} of the answers, for that matter.
lines.zh: : 或者……应该说，我{i}什么都{/i}不知道。

lines.en: : I do not expect you to.
lines.zh: : 我没指望你知道。

lines.en: : But my father always told me adults are smarter than children.
lines.zh: : 但我父亲总说，大人比小孩聪明。

lines.en: : And though I may not possess the body of a child, my mind begs to differ.
lines.zh: : 虽然我的身体早已不是小孩，我的头脑却不敢苟同。

lines.en: : There is not a single day that passes by without me misunderstanding something.
lines.zh: : 没有哪一天我不是在误解些什么中度过的。

lines.en: : I feel like an infant.
lines.zh: : 我觉得自己像个婴儿。

lines.en: : I do not think I am suited for death.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我不适合面对死亡。

lines.en: : I don’t want to be alone.
lines.zh: : 我不想孤单一人。

lines.en: : No one is {i}suited{/i} for death, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 没有人{i}适合{/i}面对死亡，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta18
: Ah-
: Please don't “Ah-” me with that look on your face. It ruins the fun.
lines.zh: : 别摆出那副表情对我“啊——”。这很扫兴。

lines.en: : It is a reaction. I can not help it.
lines.zh: : 那是一种反应。我控制不了。

lines.en: : That aside...You should probably know that you’re never going to be alone.
lines.zh: : 话说回来……你大概应该知道，你永远不会孤单一人。

lines.en: : Do you really think Molly would abandon you or make you fend for yourself in the outside world?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得 Molly 会抛弃你，或者让你一个人在外面的世界里自生自灭吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta19
: The Emerald Guardian does not like the outside world.
lines.zh: : 翡翠守护者不喜欢外面的世界。

lines.en: : She has informed me on many occasions that she is not particularly good at dealing with it and will avoid it by all means necessary.
lines.zh: : 她多次告诉我，她不太擅长应付那个世界，会不惜一切代价回避它。

lines.en: : And that’s definitely true...
lines.zh: : 这倒是真的……

lines.en: : But she’s also experienced the death of a parent.
lines.zh: : 可她也经历过父母离世。

lines.en: : That is correct. She told me about what happened to her mother.
lines.zh: : 没错。她跟我讲过她母亲的事。

lines.en: : It sounded very hard.
lines.zh: : 听起来非常难熬。

lines.en: : Will I go through the same thing?
lines.zh: : 我也会经历同样的事吗？

lines.en: : Eventually, yes.
lines.zh: : 总有一天，会。

lines.en: : A lot of the girls in class are missing a parent.
lines.zh: : 班上很多女孩都少了一位家长。

lines.en: : In fact, barely any of them have both.
lines.zh: : 事实上，几乎没人是双亲俱全的。

lines.en: : Barely any of them have {i}none{/i} either.
lines.zh: : 也很少有人是{i}双亲俱在{/i}的。

lines.en: : Also a good point.
lines.zh: : 这点也说得对。

lines.en: : If you think too much about the future, though, you’ll just run out of the present even quicker.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是把未来想得太多，只会让现在过得更快。

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta20
: You are right.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。

lines.en: : I must wait if I want to feel upset.
lines.zh: : 想难过，我也得等到那时候。

lines.en: : I still have a job to do.
lines.zh: : 我还有该做的事。

lines.en: : My father has not yet given up on living, so I should not be giving up on him.
lines.zh: : 我父亲还没有放弃活下去，那我也不该放弃他。

lines.en: : I am a failure as a daughter.
lines.zh: : 我是个失败的女儿。

lines.en: : You’re not a failure...
lines.zh: : 你不是失败者……

lines.en: : In fact, I don’t even think what you were doing just now is giving up.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我觉得你刚才那番话根本算不上放弃。

lines.en: : You’re just confused.
lines.zh: : 你只是很困惑。

lines.en: : If you were giving up, you wouldn’t have reached out to Uta for help.
lines.zh: : 如果你真放弃了，你就不会去找 Uta 求助了。

lines.en: : I wish Green Onion was able to teach me how she remains so calm in the face of death.
lines.zh: : 我真希望青葱能教教我，她面对死亡怎么会那么平静。

lines.en: : Her casualness on the subject makes me feel weak. Like there is much more for me to learn.
lines.zh: : 她在这件事上的漫不经心让我觉得自己很软弱。好像我还有太多东西要学。

lines.en: : She {i}is{/i} suspiciously casual about that and it is definitely concerning.
lines.zh: : 她平静得有点可疑，{i}确实{/i}让人担心。

lines.en: : But I don’t think you should worry too much about how other people would react to your situation.
lines.zh: : 但我觉得你不必太在意别人面对这种情况会怎么反应。

lines.en: : Just live each day as if it’s your last and you’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 只要把每一天都当成最后一天来活，就不会有问题。

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta21
: My last?!
lines.zh: : 我的最后一天？！

lines.en: : Am I next?!
lines.zh: : 我是下一个吗？！

lines.en: : Why is life so cruel all of a sudden?!
lines.zh: : 为什么人生突然变得这么残酷？！

lines.en: : It’s an expression, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 这是个比喻，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Ah!
: Your “Ah’s” are completely off tonight. It’s making me uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 你今晚的“啊”全都对不上号。让我很不舒服。

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta22
: Perhaps it would be good if I just went to sleep early...
lines.zh: : 也许我还是早点睡比较好……

lines.en: : I have heard others mention that “beauty sleep” is good for them.
lines.zh: : 我听别人说过，“美容觉”对身体有好处。

lines.en: : And I have learned recently through the art of photography that I, Tsunecchi Tojo, Warrior of Soup...am beautiful.
lines.zh: : 而且我最近通过摄影这门艺术了解到，我，Tsunecchi Tojo，汤之战士……是美丽的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyouta23
: Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : That is what the Emerald Guardian and the rest of her club told me, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少翡翠守护者和她社团的其他人是这么告诉我的。

lines.en: : And I have no reason to disbelieve them at this moment in time.
lines.zh: : 而此刻我没有理由不相信她们。

lines.en: : Well, they’re right. You should listen to them more often.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她们说得对。你该多听听她们的话。

lines.en: : If I listened to them more often, we would not be talking right now.
lines.zh: : 如果我多听她们的话，我们现在就不会在聊天了。
: ……为什么？

lines.en: : What did they say to you?
lines.zh: : 她们对你说了什么？

lines.en: : To stay away from you at all costs if I want to maintain my chastity.
lines.zh: : 说如果我想守住贞操，就要不惜一切代价离你远点。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, I do not know what chastity is, so I am not too worried about this.
lines.zh: : 可惜我不知道贞操是什么，所以我不太担心这个。

lines.en: I imagine it was Maya who told her that...
lines.zh: 我猜这话是 Maya 跟她说的……

lines.en: Though, I can see Ami saying it as well just to...thin out the competition.
lines.zh: 不过我也能想象 Ami 会说同样的话，只为了……减少竞争对手。

lines.en: : Okay, maybe {i}don’t{/i} listen to everything they say. But you can listen to the beautiful part.
lines.zh: : 好吧，也许她们说的话你{i}不用{/i}全听。但说你漂亮那句你可以听。

lines.en: : I am a free woman. You shall not tell me who I can and can not listen to.
lines.zh: : 我是自由的女人。你休想告诉我能听谁的话、不能听谁的话。

lines.en: : If you are looking for a fight, you have come to the right place.
lines.zh: : 你要是想找架打，那你可找对人了。

lines.en: : All I wanted to do was compliment you and now we have to fight?
lines.zh: : 我只是想夸你一句，现在就得打一架？

lines.en: : You brought this upon yourself.
lines.zh: : 这是你自找的。

lines.en: : Just as I will bring the pain upon your body.
lines.zh: : 正如我会把痛苦加诸你的身体。

lines.en: : Okay then. I think it’s time for me to go.
lines.zh: : 那好吧。我想我也该走了。

lines.en: : Running away from a challenge?
lines.zh: : 临阵脱逃？

lines.en: : And you call yourself a man?
lines.zh: : 你还自称是个男人？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是啊。

lines.en: : But, honestly, there’s a creeping feeling inside of me that’s saying you probably {i}would{/i} beat me in a fight and that would hurt my pride.
lines.zh: : 不过老实说，我心里隐隐有种感觉：真打起来你大概{i}会{/i}赢我，那会伤到我的自尊。

lines.en: scene black
I move toward the door and hear Tsuneyo get out of her chair.
lines.zh: 我朝门口走去，听见 Tsuneyo 从椅子上站了起来。

lines.en: : Wait.
lines.zh: : 等等。

lines.en: : What’s up?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : I feel as though I should thank you for listening to my problems.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我该谢谢你听我倾诉这些烦恼。

lines.en: : I was taught to never burden anyone, and my inability to function independently has led to me burdening you quite often.
lines.zh: : 我从小被教导绝不能给别人添麻烦，而我无法独立运转的毛病，已经让我给你添了不少麻烦。

lines.en: : Please continue to nurture me.
lines.zh: : 请继续培育我。

lines.en: Tsuneyo bows and I...can't help but feel out of place.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 鞠了一躬，而我……不禁觉得自己格格不入。

lines.en: All I did was visit her room in hopes of seeing her in another costume.
lines.zh: 我所做的不过是来她房间，指望看她再穿一次 cos 服。

lines.en: I had no idea this would turn into...whatever it turned into.
lines.zh: 我完全没想到会变成……现在这个样子。

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Though, I doubt what I’m doing could be called nurturing.
lines.zh: : 不过，我怀疑我做的事算不算培育。

lines.en: : If you think of a better word, please let me know.
lines.zh: : 要是你想到更合适的词，请告诉我。

lines.en: : I’m looking forward to learning more from you.
lines.zh: : 我很期待从你身上学到更多。
